gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-medefaidri: Strokes that hold their width through every turn give Bevellier a cut-from-sheet look, tight and graceful. And Noto Sans Medefaidrin lifts its lowercase high, with curves that turn without any ink pooling, so paragraphs keep moving.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-palmyrene: Bevellier looks drawn with a single pen tip, graceful and tightly spaced. Noto Sans Palmyrene takes below with curves that stop short of closing, so the heading holds the personality and the sans-serif body stays out of its way.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-psalter-pa: Bevellier looks like bent wire, every stroke held constant. What stands out is how wire-tight display letters meet a body with gaping e mouths and barely rising capitals in Noto Sans Psalter Pahlavi.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-runic: Noto Sans Runic stretches its lowercase tall, with little ascender room above and curves that never close back on themselves. The standout is Bevellier, whose curves match its stems exactly.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-samaritan: Bevellier cuts its diagonals to match its stems. Against that tight, graceful display, Noto Sans Samaritan brings hefty lowercase and curves with plenty of daylight inside, and the gap between them is the draw.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-sunuwar: Graceful and sophisticated, Bevellier looks bent from a single wire. Noto Sans Sunuwar then lets curves leave daylight like a rope's open bight, with short ascender stems on tall lowercase bodies, so reading rolls on.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-syriac: Noto Sans Syriac has tall lowercase bowls like blown glass bulbs. Bevellier, with strokes constant as bent wire, holds the headline while those generous bowls and easy s turns fill out the text beneath.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-tagalog: Sophisticated, Bevellier draws bowls and stems in matching weight. Noto Sans Tagalog fills the line with a dominant middle zone and generous gaps in its curves, a quieter partner under the heading's tight, display-sized letters.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-tamil: Strokes pulled like solder through a nozzle give Bevellier its tight, graceful look. Noto Sans Tamil already looks magnified without any change in size, its terminals stopping far from the stem.
gen-fs-bevellier-gf-noto-sans-tc: Tight and graceful, like letters outlined in one steady line. Bevellier earns its keep big and brief, while Noto Sans TC lets its large counters open outward instead of curling in.
